label: Shielded — between him and the lantern lines
location: The Palisade Camp, the lane to the far gate
injuries: Burned palms from throwing his own festival charges back on schedule
A gash above one eye he has not had time to feel

recentEvents.value: The settlement is emptying behind him, keg by keg, family by family; the fireworks meant for the finale are going off as walls.

unresolvedConflicts.value: He is spending the feast — the thing he was elected to protect — on the one guest who will not leave.

temporaryObjective.value: Hold the lane until the last lantern line is over the palisade's far gate.
